findings.claim: The documentation now makes a false repository-wide claim that no code reads FLINT_ANON_KEY or FLINT_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, while this same diff adds test code that reads both variables.
findings.evidence: docs/ANON-SERVICE-ROLE-KEYS.md adds: “No code in this repository reads `FLINT_ANON_KEY` or `FLINT_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`… Grep the workspace: zero readers.”; crates/fdb-gateway/tests/provisioning_prereqs.rs adds `env_nonempty("FLINT_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")` and `env_nonempty("FLINT_ANON_KEY")`. Acceptance criterion 4 only required saying no Forge code reads `FLINT_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` as config, not the stronger false “zero readers” claim.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the documentation to the narrower required statement, e.g. “Forge runtime code does not read these as configuration; tests may consume them as externally supplied bearer tokens.”
